{{Short description|Mexican ichthyologist (1943–2011)}}
'''José Luis Castro Aguirre''' (24 June 1943 – 20 January 2011) was a Mexican [[ichthyology|ichthyologist]]. He was a founding member of the Mexican Ichthyological Society and a member of the [[Sistema Nacional de Investigadores|National System of Investigators]] who produced around 150 publications, focusing chiefly on the taxonomy, ecology, and [[biogeography]] of the fishes of Mexico.<ref name="Aguero2011">{{cite journal|last1=De La Cruz Agüero|first1=J.|title=José Luis Castro Aguirre, mainstay of contemporary ichthyology in Mexico|journal=Journal of Fish Biology|date=2011|volume=78|issue=5|pages=1291–1293|doi=10.1111/j.1095-8649.2011.02980.x|bibcode=2011JFBio..78.1291D }}</ref> His 1978 book ''Catálogo sistemático de los peces marinos que penetran en aguas continentales de México, con aspectos zoogeográficos y ecológicos'' (''"Systematic catalog of marine fish entering inland waters of Mexico, with zoogeographical and ecological aspects"'') was the first catalog of [[estuarine]] fishes of Mexico.<ref name=Smith1980>{{cite journal|last1=Smith|first1=Michael Leonard|title=Review: ''Catalogo Sistematico de Los Peces Marinos Que Penetran a Las Aguas Continentales de Mexico con Aspectos Zoogeographicos y Ecologicos''|journal=Copeia|date=1980|volume=1980|issue=1|pages=184|doi=10.2307/1444165|jstor=1444165}}</ref> Born in [[Mexico City]], he attended the [[Escuela Nacional de Ciencias Biológicas|National School of Biological Sciences]] at the [[Instituto Politécnico Nacional|National Polytechnic Institute]] (ENCB-IPN) earning a master's degree in 1974 and a PhD in 1986. He worked at the National Fisheries Institute and the [[Food and Agriculture Organization]] in the 1960s, and later was professor and researcher at the ENCB-IPN, [[Universidad Autónoma Metropolitana]] (UAM; 1979–1987), the Interdisciplinary Center of Marine Science (CICIMAR; 1976–1979, 1994–2011) and Northeast Center of Biological Research (CIBNOR; 1987–1994).<ref name=Aguero2011/> He described around a dozen fish species, including several species of shark.<ref name="Aguero2011" /><ref name="WatkinsBeolens2015">{{cite book|first1=Michael|last1 =Watkins|first2=Bo|last2=Beolens|title=Sharks: An Eponym Dictionary|url=https://books.google.com/books?id=tLvlBgAAQBAJ&pg=PA25|year=2015|publisher=Pelagic Publishing Ltd|isbn=978-1-78427-037-7|page=25}}</ref> A book of research papers in his honor was produced in 2012.<ref>{{cite book|editor1=Del Moral Flores, Luis Fernando|editor2=Martínez Pérez, José Antonio|editor3=López, Jonathan Franco|editor4=Ramírez Villalobos, Ángeles Jaqueline|editor5=Tello Musi, José Luis|title=Investigación Ictiológica en México: Temas selectos en Honor al Dr. José Luis Castro Aguirre|date=2012|publisher=Universidad Nacional Autónoma de México|isbn=9786070236280}}</ref>

==Taxon described by him==
* The [[Pacific spoon-nose eel]], ''Echiophis brunneus''.
* The [[Mexican hornshark]] ''Heterodontus mexicanus''

== Taxon named in his honor ==
* He was posthumously commemorated in the names of the fish species ''[[Hypoplectrus castroaguirrei]]'' (a [[Hamlet (fish)|hamlet]])<ref>{{cite journal|last1=Del Moral Flores|first1= L.F.|first2= J.L.|last2= Tello-Musi|first3=J.A.|last3=Martínez-Pérez|year= 2012|title= Descripcíon de una nueva especie del género ''Hypoplectrus'' (Actinopterigy: Serrandae) del Sistema Arrecifa Veracruzana, suroeste de Golfo de México|journal= Revista de Zoología|volume= 22|pages=1–10|language=Spanish, English}}</ref>  and  ''[[Eugerres castroaguirrei]]'' (a [[mojarra]]).<ref>{{cite journal|last1=Gonzalez-Acosta|first1=Adrian F.|last2=Rodiles-Hernandez|first2=Rocio|title=New species of ''Eugerres'' from the Usumacinta Province, México and Guatemala with a redescription of ''E. mexicanus'' (Steindachner, 1863) (Teleostei: Gerreidae)|journal=Neotropical Ichthyology|date=2013|volume=11|issue=2|pages=307–318|doi=10.1590/S1679-62252013000200009|doi-access=free}}</ref>
